Missing: a sheet that lists the library with thumbnails, tracks the selection against the limit and answers the pending call.

entries.name: _PhotosUI_WidgetKit
entries.note: Open: depends on the PhotosPicker sheet (see _PhotosUI_SwiftUI), which the shell lacks, and on a photo widget kind that reads a chosen asset. The widget runtime exists (sdk widgets.rs) but no widget family shows library pictures, and the configuration cannot pick one.

entries.name: _Photos_AppIntents
entries.note: Remaining from data file photokit (refreshed 2026-10-17): No asset creation and no user collections in the SDK. isFavorite is read from the asset record (is_favorite in springboard/sdk/src/photo_library.rs), so the old "always false" statement is stale. | The picker call exists (PHPickerViewController), but the shell refuses it: there is no picker sheet yet, so apps fall back to their own picker. | No Live Photo support in the library or the viewer (PHLivePhoto). | Movie pixel size is not read (reported as 0 x 0); movies are listed as video assets. | The editing and project contracts exist in the SDK (photo_editing.rs, photo_project.rs), but the Photos app hosts no third-party editor or project extension. | No PHPhotoLibraryChangeObserver object and no per-asset permission grants. Change details and the observe push exist (springboard/ui/src/photo_changes.rs). | Metadata is read from JPEG and PNG only (HEIC and RAW are not); no extended asset metadata object for apps. Built 2026-10-17: PhotoAsset and PhotoAlbum entities and open, open-album and favourite intents (sdk photo_intents, tests photo_intents::tests).
entries.ready_note: Photo App Intents are the PhotoAsset and PhotoAlbum entities and the open-photo, open-album and set-photo-favourite intents (sdk photo_intents) over the library asset records and the smart albums. Host tests cover entity building, album queries and parameter validation; the Photos app has not adopted the intents in its manifest yet.

The DSP graph is not built.
entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17: smart transitions between songs. The audio engine holds the end of a song back and mixes the next song's start under it with equal-power gains (crossfade_overlap::Crossfader, wired into audioplayer; the overlap is capped at half a song and off for live stations), audiod takes it as the SetCrossfade command, and Music's Controls > Crossfade Songs menu sends the saved length (playback.txt) when the library store opens and when it changes. Gapless playback stays the default. Not built: the reference's DSP graph and per-song transition styles (beat-matched mixes); only the crossfade is.

entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17: the media player's views and pickers. The fullscreen player view (HUD, scrubbing, skips) plays through media::player, which now takes a playback rate (0.5x to 3x, the audio time-stretched, the picture clock at the same rate; player::tests). The Video Player app's Playback menu offers the speed picker and a subtitle picker over every per-language sidecar file (name.en.srt; playback::tests, movie::tests, subtitles::tests), and the route picker menu is drawn by shell pickers over media::route. Not built: speed and subtitle buttons in the on-screen HUD (they are menu rows), and embedded subtitle tracks (only sidecar files).

entries.name: _ToolKit_AppIntents
entries.note: Overlay of the action toolkit for App Intents, covered by the intent catalogue and runner listed in bifrost.
entries.ready_note: Overlay that exposes the action toolkit (intent and entity metadata) to App Intents code. In BifrOSt the same job is the intent catalogue and runner: apps declare intents in manifest.toml, and the shell intents, Search, Settings intents, entity index and the SDK intents module list, resolve and run them (the same checks as the AppIntents rows).
